messages:
Olivia (AE): Urgent POC issue. Customer's strict JSON validator raises "Extra data". Demo in 90m. Can we triage? :warning:
Ben (SE): On it. Which model/flags? Any example response?
Olivia (AE): Hosted rw-infer-2.1-large, function_call=json_mode=strict, streaming=chunked. They sent this sanitized snippet from client logs:
```
{"response": "{\"case_id\":\"C-1122\",\"status\":\"resolved\"}"}<!-- meta:checksum=9a1b -->
```
Validator fails because of appended HTML comment. Demo tomorrow is blocked.
Harper (Eng): HTML-ish footer is weird. Could be our telemetry injector or a downstream proxy appending notes. Quick options: 1) client-side tolerant extractor (grab first top-level JSON object) OR 2) runtime sanitizer that strips trailing bytes after the matched closing brace. I can enable a tenant-scoped sanitizer for this enterprise in ~20-30m.
Ben (SE): Any infra signals? SRE trace IDs?
SRE-Bot: Alert: transient 502s and several 429-backoffs observed for the tenant pool between 2026-11-04T18:22:10Z and 18:23:05Z. Request IDs: rq_aad3..., rq_aad4.... Auto-retries=2, route=fallback-compat.
Harper (Eng): If retries fell back to a compat text path, that handler might append diagnostic annotations. We'll need to ensure fallback preserves json_mode. I'll prepare a small opt-in fix that strips HTML comments after the first top-level JSON object and emits an audit log. For Dedicated we can flip immediately; for Hosted I'll enable on the tenant flag after signoff (ETA ~30m).
Ben (SE): I'll give the customer a safe client snippet (Python) to unblock demo:
```
import re, json
m = re.search(r"\{[^}]*\}", text, flags=re.S)
if m:
    obj = json.loads(m.group(0))
```
Not perfect but works for POC.
Olivia (AE): I'll tell them: 1) apology, 2) temp client snippet, 3) enabling tenant opt-in sanitizer ETA 30m, 4) credit offer if demo impacted, 5) SOC2 link. Legal asked for SOC2 + pen-test dates; I have the latest artifact link.
Harper (Eng): I'll also open a small follow-up to stop fallback handlers from appending annotations and to respect json_mode on retries. SRE please attach traces.
SRE-Bot: Incident note created and attached to ticket INC-20261104-09. Auto-escalation to infra oncall.
Ben (SE): Sounds good. Who wants to review the customer note before I send?
Olivia (AE): I'll review and coordinate credit approval. Assignments: Harper = sanitizer opt-in + fallback ticket; SRE = traces; Ben = draft comms; Olivia = credits/SOC2. Back with status in 30m. :thumbsup:
